combo.description: Use your R then Q, then W to reposition before using your E!
Flash and W onto your enemy, then Q and E!
Lead with W then Q, W, charge your E then hit that R!
Q to an ally, then W, W, E and a few AA's to finish.
Pop your R then W, Q, W and E!
Pop your W, then W again, Q and then E.
Lead with Q then charge your E, then W, and W again!
Charge up your E, then Q, AA, W, W, and AA to finish.
